text: Branch opening hours: Monday to Friday 9:30 to 16:30. Saturday 10:00 to 13:00. All branches are closed on Sundays and public holidays.
Checking your account balance: verify with your registered phone number and date of birth, then hear your savings or current account balance. Balances are also shown in the mobile app.
Lost or stolen debit or credit card: we block the card immediately after verifying your registered phone number. A replacement card is delivered in 5 to 7 working days.
Fixed deposit interest rates: 1 year 6.5% per annum, 2 years 6.8% per annum. Senior citizens receive an additional 0.5%.
Money transfers to another account or a family member are done in the mobile app or at a branch. Phone agents cannot move money.
Duplicate or double charges: raise a dispute and the extra charge is refunded within 7 working days. Hotel and travel bookings charged twice are covered.
Old city heritage tour: two days, 8,000 rupees per adult, children under 10 half price. Bookings need the names of all travellers. Flights and hotels can be added to a tour booking.
Evening river cruise: departs 18:30, two hours. Vegetarian and vegan meals available on request when booking.
Speak to a person: human colleagues are available Monday to Saturday 9:00 to 19:00. Ask the assistant to transfer you.
ATM fees: the first five withdrawals per month at other banks' ATMs are free, then 21 rupees per withdrawal.
Personal loans: up to 15 lakh rupees, tenure 1 to 5 years, EMI calculator available in the app.
Visa assistance for international tours: we help with documents for Japan, Thailand and Singapore visas. Processing takes 10 to 15 days.
Airport pickup: available for all tour packages, book at least 48 hours ahead.
